messages:
dana: Quick flag from CSM: Tempora noticed a spike on INV-2026-1201. They say we billed shared-spot for 00:00-00:15 UTC even though their reserved commit should have covered that window. Can ops/billing triage?
keegan: can you paste the invoice lines and meter pointer?
dana: snippet below (trimmed):
```
line_id,pool_id,zone,period_start,period_end,gpu_hours,unit_rate
T-13111,reserved-tempora-eu,eu-west-1,2026-12-01T00:00Z,2026-12-01T01:00Z,10.0,2.10
T-13112,shared-spot,eu-west-1,2026-12-01T00:00Z,2026-12-01T00:15Z,2.5,4.50
```
ops-bot: Meter export available at s3://exports/tempora/2026-12/meter-1201.csv (sha1: z9x8y).
mira: infra note: our metering uses hour buckets anchored to the account's billing timezone. Tempora's account was recently switched to CET as part of a legal-region change; the bucket anchor shifted and an edge-case in our bucket-rollover created a 00:00-00:15 fragment that was attributed to `shared-spot` before the reserved pool's new anchor applied. Essentially off-by-timezone-window (15m) misattribution.
keegan: calc: 2.5 gpu-hours * $4.50 = $11.25. Customer expects this to be covered by their 10 gpu-hours reserved commit at $2.10. Credit delta = (2.5*(4.50-2.10)) = $6.00. Invoice shows full $11.25 charge on burst line.
dana: Tempora is pressing because they changed timezone for compliance reasons and didn't expect billing differences. Recommend immediate provisional credit of $11.25 while we recompute and backfill the reserved attribution; then we'll recover the partner/vendor if needed. Thoughts?
keegan: policy check  provisional credits < $100 are fine with CSM signoff. GL: BILLING_TIMEZONE_ADJ. Approve?
mira: also root-cause: our bucket roll function used server-local midnight instead of customer-anchor midnight in one code path. I'll patch in a timezone-aware anchor check and run a backfill. ETA for patch: 36h. Backfill job ETA: 48h.
finance-bot: Approved per billing policy. Please include a one-line justification.
dana: justification: "provisional refund for misattributed usage due to billing timezone anchor regression after account timezone change."
keegan: done. Applied CR-2026-990 for $11.25 to INV-2026-1201 and created FIN-2026-840 to track the backfill and reconciliation. Accounting notified.
dana: customer message draft: "We found a timezone-anchor bug that briefly misattributed 00:00-00:15 usage to shared-spot. We've applied a provisional credit of $11.25 while we recompute your invoice; final reconciliation within 5 business days." Approve language?
mira: fine. Also adding a note that we'll run an audit for other accounts that changed timezone in the last 30 days.
keegan: vendor consideration: vendor-bot shows the host cloud billed us for those minutes as shared instances (they're not contractually liable for timezone misattribution). We'll still attempt internal recovery but partner likely not responsible. Open vendor ticket VND-4799 for completeness?
vendor-bot: VND-4799 created for vendor ops to confirm metering alignment; assigned.
dana: ok send to Tempora. CS sent and customer replied appreciative but asked for prevention steps.
mira: action items: 1) timezone-anchor fix (36h), 2) backfill + audit job (48h), 3) add a subtle note in account settings when changing timezone: "changing billing timezone may affect bucket alignment; we will run a reconciliation". I'll file ENG-REQ-552.
keegan: closing notes: provisional credit applied CR-2026-990 ($11.25), FIN-2026-840 tracks reconciliation, ENG-REQ-552 for prevention, vendor ticket VND-4799 opened. Leaving thread open until backfill completes. :thumbsup:
dana: Tempora acknowledged and thanked us. Marking as resolved on our side pending backfill. :white_check_mark:
